properties.Description: Descriptor definitions for reusable MAP queries and their direct runtime execution state. Dance-mediated invocation is owned by the separate Query Dance Adapter Schema.
Reusable saved query definition rooted at a QueryExpression. It never carries invocation state.
Reusable query-expression definition. Concrete operators extend this type.
Composite QueryExpression whose ordered Subtree members are implementation containment, not continuation.
Root-only source expression. Expands the invocation's focal HolonSpace over its Owns relationship; accepts no input collection. SeedPredicate is an optional payload with no QRY2 evaluation.
Navigation expression. Expands each input member over the named outbound relationship resolved through the member's HolonDescriptor. ExpansionPredicate is an optional payload with no QRY2 evaluation.
Abstract predicate attached to a query expression. Concrete predicate forms, operators, and evaluation are defined by later slices.
Reusable declaration of a parameter accepted by a query expression.
Runtime value binding for a QueryParameterDeclaration. Concrete binding types own their values.
Runtime state for one direct or Dance-mediated execution of a Query.
Runtime state for one invocation of one QueryExpression.
Human-readable name for a saved Query.
Human-readable description of a Query.
Stable name of a declared or runtime query parameter.
Name of the outbound relationship an Expand expression navigates; resolved against each source member's HolonDescriptor at execution time.
Lifecycle status of a Query execution.
Lifecycle states for a Query execution.
Execution has been created but has not started.
Execution is in progress.
Execution completed successfully.
Execution completed with failure.
Identifies the root expression of a Query definition.
Inverse of RootExpression.
Lists reusable parameter declarations required by a QueryExpression.
Inverse of ExpressionParameters.
The sole sequential continuation relationship for QueryExpression execution.
Inverse of Next.
Identifies the concrete QueryParameterBinding descriptor accepted by a declaration.
Inverse of ParameterBindingType.
Identifies the declaration satisfied by a runtime query parameter binding.
Inverse of BindsParameter.
Contains the ordered implementation subtree of a composite QueryExpression.
Inverse of Subtree.
Identifies the Query executed by this runtime instance.
Inverse of ExecutesQuery.
Identifies the focal HolonSpace supplied as invocation context for this transient execution. Never recorded on the reusable Query definition.
Inverse of FocalSpace.
Owns the ordered runtime executions of a Query's expressions.
Inverse of ExpressionExecutions.
Records the final HolonCollection of a completed Query execution.
Inverse of ExecutionResult.
Identifies the reusable QueryExpression invoked by runtime execution state.
Inverse of ExecutesExpression.

Records the runtime input collection for one expression invocation. Optional at this base boundary; the concrete root expression decides whether a collection operand is required, forbidden, or supplied by a predecessor.
Inverse of Input.
Records the runtime result collection for one expression invocation.
Inverse of Result.
Optional predicate payload attached to a SeedHolons expression. Definition state only; QRY2 neither evaluates nor pushes it down.
Inverse of SeedPredicate.
Optional predicate payload attached to an Expand expression. Definition state only; QRY2 neither evaluates nor pushes it down.
Inverse of ExpansionPredicate.
Records resolved runtime bindings for one expression invocation.
Inverse of RuntimeParameters.
Collection transformation that returns the input occurrences stably sorted by one through five ordered OrderBySpecs. It neither deduplicates nor projects.
One sort key of an OrderBy: the name of the property to sort by, its direction, and where members missing that value are placed.
Collection transformation that removes the first SkipCount occurrences and preserves the order of the rest.
Collection transformation that retains at most LimitCount leading occurrences.

Collection transformation that retains the first occurrence of each holon reference identity and preserves the relative order of retained occurrences. Identity is reference equality, never property values.
Name of the property an OrderBySpec sorts by, resolved at execution time against each input member's effective property surface. No default.
Direction in which an OrderBySpec orders present values. Evaluation resolves an absent value to the descriptor default without writing it.
Placement of members missing the sorted value, independent of SortDirection. Evaluation resolves an absent value to the descriptor default without writing it.
Nonnegative number of leading occurrences a Skip removes. No default.
Nonnegative maximum number of occurrences a Limit retains. No default.
Direction in which an OrderBySpec orders present values.
Smaller present values sort first.
Larger present values sort first.
Placement of members missing an OrderBySpec's value, independent of direction.
Members missing the value sort before every present value.
Members missing the value sort after every present value.
Ordered sort keys of an OrderBy; target order is sort precedence.
Inverse of OrderBySpecs.
